Definition: perhaps from G2046; Hermes, the name of the messenger of the Greek deities; also of a Christian:--Hermes, Mercury.
BiblicalUsage: Hermes is a person named 2 times in Scripture, in Acts and Romans. The full story lives on the Hermes profile, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hermes matters because God keeps names in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
